messages:
sophie: Heads-up — customer reported apparent double-charge when we did a mid-stream model swap yesterday. They streamed ~3k tokens, we swapped to smaller quantized model at t+1.6s, then client retried after a 502 and we ended up charging for overlap + truncated suffix.

raj: ugh. is this the session-handoff path where we forward partial kv cache and then truncate?

sophie: yep. sequence: initial stream -> model-swap (forced shorter max_tokens) -> truncated final event -> client saw EOF 502 -> client retried full request -> routing sent to fallback model and billed from prefix again. customer sees ~1.8x tokens.

mike: can you paste the logs? maybe we double-accounted the truncated tokens as "confirmed" + then again on retry provisional.

sophie: logs:
```
[stream-id=abc123] served tokens=3072 confirmed=2800 trunc_reason=swap_maxlen
[handoff] prefetched_prefix_tokens=2800 kv_hash=0x9a7b
[retry] new-session id=def456 routed_to=fallback-q4 served_tokens=1900 provisional=true
```

raj: that trunc_reason=swap_maxlen is critical. currently our ledger marks tokens as confirmed on chunk commit, but we also have provisional credits for prefetched prefixes during handoff. if truncation happens mid-handoff we need to reconcile.

devex-ana: quick question — how does console show this to customer now? do they see two separate charges or a merged subtotal?

carter: console shows two line-items: one for original session (full amount) and one for retry. we have no auto-reconcile because provisional credits sit in a different namespace.

mike: short-term mitigation: when truncation_reason in {swap_maxlen, model_trunc} AND a retry follows within Xs with same client_id, mark the earlier provisional as superseded and issue a credit (provisional->reclaimed) instead of confirmed. but need to be careful about race with in-flight confirms.

raj: agree. also need to avoid doing this for tool-calls because those have side-effects and we can't silently refund. toolcalls should keep confirmed behavior.

sophie: good catch. so rule: if truncation happened before any tool-call side-effect AND prefetched_prefix_tokens > 0 AND retry routed to different model variant -> auto-credit and surface as "merged session" in console.

devex-ana: UX: show merged badge + single combined tokens line with hover explaining auto-credit. customer support won't have to manual dispute.

mike: implementation notes: adjust ledger state machine: add state PROVISIONAL_SUPERSEDED with timestamp, reason, and link to retry_session_id. reconcile job will turn PROVISIONAL_SUPERSEDED -> CREDITED after idempotent write to billing. also emit tracing span billing.reconcile.handoff.

carter: can we do a canary for Trusted tier only? avoid changing behavior for all orgs.

raj: yes. add routing policy flag allow_handoff_reclaim, default false. roll out to internal + trusted beta.

ops-bot: deploy-plan: patch billing-worker, add unit tests for edgecases, feature-flag gated, observability: add metric billing.reclaims.count and sample traces to s3.

sophie: I'll file a tiny RFC + customer-facing note. owners: raj (design), mike (billing impl), devex-ana (console), carter (canary rollout).

mike: one more: update eval harness so model-swap tests include a simulated retry within 2s to catch regressions.

sophie: thanks all. follow-ups: RFC link once created. ping me if you want to join the quick sync 11:15. :slightly_smiling_face:
